name: com.cobaltcapture/cobalt
title: Cobalt Capture
description: Website studies your agent runs for you, returned as a shareable review with real screenshots.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Fetch a Cobalt Capture review by its share link or slug. Returns the reviewer's notes as text AND each annotated screenshot as an image, so you can see exactly what was marked and what to change.

review.description: A Cobalt review URL (https://cobaltcapture.com/r/<slug> or /s/<slug>) or just the slug.

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Start a new Cobalt Capture review and get a handle for filling it in. Use this to compile the findings of any site study — a usability pass, a pricing teardown, a positioning audit, a QA run — into one shareable, durable report with real screenshots. Works from any client, chat assistants included: with no browser, add_screenshot(page_url=...) renders the pages for you. Returns a `review` slug and a `claim_token` — pass BOTH back to add_screenshot / add_note to append content. Also returns a `review_url` to share and a `save_url` the human opens (while signed in) to save the review to their account permanently. The review is anonymous and auto-deletes after 30 days unless saved.

product_url.description: Optional URL of the product/site under review.

summary.description: Optional overview shown at the top of the review (plain text or markdown). Good place for the overall task, outcome, and headline findings.

title.description: Title of the review, e.g. 'Onboarding walkthrough — Jupiter Invoice'.

tools.name: add_screenshot
tools.description: Append one screenshot, with an optional title and note, to the end of a review. The image is stored in Cobalt and shown in the review. Three ways to supply it: `page_url`, a public page that Cobalt renders in a headless browser (`viewport` 'desktop' at 1280px or 'mobile' at 390px, `full_page` for the whole scroll, `hide_selectors` for elements to hide; common cookie banners are hidden automatically), which also returns the rendered image; `image_url`, an image already uploaded to https://cobaltcapture.com/api/upload; or `image`, a small base64 image. This tool only appends; it never changes an existing item (replace_screenshot does that).

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

comment.description: Optional note describing what this screen shows or what's wrong with it.

full_page.description: With page_url: capture the entire scrollable page instead of the first viewport. Default false. Pages that scroll inside an inner container come back viewport-sized.

hide_selectors.description: With page_url: extra CSS selectors to hide before the shot, e.g. ['#newsletter-modal', '.chat-widget']. Common cookie and consent banners are hidden on every render.

image.description: A small base64-encoded PNG, JPEG or WebP (data: URL prefix accepted). Intended for images under about 100 KB; larger screenshots are better uploaded and passed as image_url.

image_url.description: An image URL on Cobalt's own image host, as returned by https://cobaltcapture.com/api/upload (multipart field `file`, returns {url, key}) or by the editor's window.cobaltGrab(). External URLs are refused.

page_url.description: A public http(s) page for Cobalt to render and screenshot server-side. Pages behind a login can't be rendered. Becomes the item's source_url unless one is passed. Takes 10 to 30 seconds; a site that blocks automated browsers returns an error.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

source_url.description: Optional URL of the page the screenshot was taken on.

title.description: Optional short caption for the screenshot.

viewport.description: With page_url: 'desktop' (1280x800, default) or 'mobile' (390x844 phone, 2x, touch).

tools.name: replace_screenshot
tools.description: Overwrite one existing screenshot in a review with a new capture, in the same position. Destructive: the old image and any pins or annotations on it are removed and cannot be recovered; the title and comment change only if new ones are passed. Works on screenshots only, not notes. Takes the same capture arguments as add_screenshot, plus `item`, the 1-based number of the screenshot to replace.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

comment.description: Optional note describing what this screen shows or what's wrong with it.

full_page.description: With page_url: capture the entire scrollable page instead of the first viewport. Default false. Pages that scroll inside an inner container come back viewport-sized.

hide_selectors.description: With page_url: extra CSS selectors to hide before the shot, e.g. ['#newsletter-modal', '.chat-widget']. Common cookie and consent banners are hidden on every render.

image.description: A small base64-encoded PNG, JPEG or WebP (data: URL prefix accepted). Intended for images under about 100 KB; larger screenshots are better uploaded and passed as image_url.

image_url.description: An image URL on Cobalt's own image host, as returned by https://cobaltcapture.com/api/upload (multipart field `file`, returns {url, key}) or by the editor's window.cobaltGrab(). External URLs are refused.

item.description: The 1-based number of the existing screenshot item to overwrite (as it appears in the review, counting notes).

page_url.description: A public http(s) page for Cobalt to render and screenshot server-side. Pages behind a login can't be rendered. Becomes the item's source_url unless one is passed. Takes 10 to 30 seconds; a site that blocks automated browsers returns an error.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

source_url.description: Optional URL of the page the screenshot was taken on.

title.description: Optional short caption for the screenshot.

viewport.description: With page_url: 'desktop' (1280x800, default) or 'mobile' (390x844 phone, 2x, touch).

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Append a free-standing text note (not tied to a screenshot) to a review created by create_review. Use for context, steps taken, or a summary of findings between screenshots.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

text.description: The note text (plain text or markdown).

tools.name: update_review
tools.description: Set or replace a review's summary and/or title. The summary is shown at the top of the review, above every screenshot and note. Replaces any existing summary or title.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

compared_to.description: Optional: when this run repeats an earlier study, the earlier review's slug or URL. Recorded so re-runs can be compared over time.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

summary.description: The overview shown at the top of the review. Replaces any existing summary.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Return the full text of a Cobalt study playbook: a step-by-step method for a kind of product review that ends in a shareable Cobalt review. Available: 'pricing_teardown' (can a buyer tell what they would pay and which tier fits; public pages only); 'website_teardown' (what each key page leads with and says, judged as a first-time visitor; public pages only; 'positioning_pass' is its old name); 'comparison_study' (two or three products compared for one buying decision, with a sourced matrix; public pages plus web search); 'usability_pass' (a first-time-user audit: a new user signs up and tries to get real jobs done, judged as a whole experience; needs a browser); 'flow_pass' (one specific flow the user names, such as checkout or inviting a teammate, walked step by step including its emails; needs a browser); 'investigation_pass' (a product investigation of an app the user owns, run in its own environment; needs a browser and usually the code); 'design_pass' (what the product looks like across nine phone, tablet and desktop sizes with menus, dialogs and forms opened: uneven padding, near-miss alignment, cut-off or colliding text, and a few hard fundamentals, nominated by a script in the page; needs a browser). The public-page studies work without a browser because add_screenshot(page_url) renders pages server-side. The same methods are offered as MCP prompts, and every playbook's full text is published at https://cobaltcapture.com/developers#playbooks. Each one tells the user its plan before acting, and the ones that sign up or use a product stop for the user's approval first.

companion_of.description: design_pass only: the URL of the usability or scenario review this pass accompanies.

url.description: The site to run it against, if you already know it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the studies Cobalt Capture has published on well-known products: pricing teardowns, positioning audits, and head-to-head comparisons (for example Canva pricing, Spotify vs Apple Music). Returns matching studies as {id, title, url}; pass an id to fetch for the full text. It does NOT search private reviews, which are reachable only by their link (use get_review, or fetch with the review URL).

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'canva pricing' or 'spotify'.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a Cobalt study by the id search returned, or of any Cobalt review by its URL (/r/<slug>) or slug. Returns text: findings, prices, the comparison matrix, and the underlying review's notes with links to its screenshots. Use get_review instead when you need to see the screenshots as images.

id.description: An id from search (e.g. 'teardown:canva'), or a review URL or slug.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create a temporary email inbox for testing the signup or email flow of a product the user owns or is authorised to test, within that product's terms. Returns an `address` to enter in the product's form and an `inbox_token` for reading it with check_inbox. Each inbox expires 24 hours after it is created, receives mail only (it cannot send), and accepts mail only while it exists. Up to 20 inboxes can be created per hour from one IP address.

review.description: Optional review slug this inbox belongs to — a label for your own bookkeeping.

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: Read mail delivered to an inbox from create_inbox, newest first, for example a verification code or confirmation link from the signup email of the product being tested. Requires the inbox_token, so only whoever created the inbox can read it. Returns immediately; mail usually arrives within seconds, so an empty result can be checked again shortly. format="html" returns each message's HTML for reviewing the email's design.

format.description: "text" (default) returns each message flattened to readable text, with link targets kept. "html" returns the raw HTML part.

tools.name: email_review
tools.description: Email a link to a review to the person who ran the study. Sends only to an address that belongs to a verified Cobalt account (other addresses are refused, which keeps the tool from being used to send unsolicited mail). The email contains only the review link, never text supplied in the call.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (proves you created this review), or, for a saved review, the agent token its owner generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent).

email.description: The human's Cobalt account email. Must belong to a verified account, or the send is refused.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

tools.name: mark_screenshot
tools.description: Set the pins and shapes drawn on one screenshot in a review, the same marks a person draws in the editor. Pass `pins`, `shapes` or both; each one you pass replaces that item's existing list, and one you leave out is kept. Returns the marked image so you can check the placement. The marks appear on the review page and in every export.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (or the owner's agent token).

item.description: 1-based position of the item in the review, as get_review numbers them.

pins.description: Numbered pins, in order (pin 1 first). Each is {x, y}: fractions of the image's width and height from its top-left corner, 0 to 1. The pin's numbered circle is drawn centred on that point and covers what is under it, so place it beside the thing it marks. An empty list removes every pin.

shapes.description: Arrows, boxes, circles and text labels. Coordinates are fractions 0 to 1 from the top-left. arrow: x1,y1 is the tail and x2,y2 the head. box and circle: opposite corners. text: x1,y1 is the top-left of a single-line label (up to 140 characters) with size s, m or l. Colors: red, orange, yellow, green, pink, black, white. An empty list removes every shape.

tools.name: edit_item
tools.description: Change one item in a review: its title, its comment, its position, or (for a screenshot) crop it. `crop` is {x, y, w, h} in fractions 0 to 1 of the current image; cropping removes the item's pins and shapes, since their positions were relative to the old image. `move_to` is the new 1-based position. Fields you leave out are unchanged.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (or the owner's agent token).

comment.description: New comment text, replacing the old one.

crop.description: Crop rectangle in fractions of the image.

item.description: 1-based position of the item in the review, as get_review numbers them.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Remove one screenshot or note from a review. The items after it move up one place. This cannot be undone.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (or the owner's agent token).

item.description: 1-based position of the item in the review, as get_review numbers them.

tools.name: delete_review
tools.description: Permanently delete a whole review: its items, comments and screenshots. Its link stops working for everyone it was shared with. This cannot be undone. Only the review's owner (a signed-in connection) or the agent that created an unsaved review (its claim_token) can delete it; an agent token handed over from the review page cannot.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (or the owner's agent token).

tools.name: export_review
tools.description: Return download links for a review as PDF, Word (.docx), markdown and a standalone HTML file, the same files the review page's Export menu gives. Anyone with a link can open it.
